svg.data-what: a sarcomere, the contracting unit of a muscle fibre, relaxed

rect.data-what: the I band: thin filaments only, light under the microscope; it shortens when the muscle contracts
the I band on the other side
the A band: the length of the thick filaments, dark under the microscope; it keeps its length
the H zone: thick filaments only, between the ends of the thin filaments; it narrows when the muscle contracts

g.data-what: thin filaments of actin, anchored in the Z disc; pulled toward the middle when the muscle contracts
thin filaments of actin from the right Z disc
titin: a giant elastic protein running from the Z disc to the thick filament, like a spring
thick filaments of myosin; their heads grab the thin filaments and pull them toward the M line

rect.data-what: the M line, holding the thick filaments together at the middle

path.data-what: the Z disc, the border of the sarcomere where the thin filaments are anchored
the Z disc at the other border
